note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. The Self-Defense Forces are all-volunteer (no conscription since 1945). Universal public health insurance (kokumin kaihoken) has operated since 1961. Article 20 of the Constitution separates religion and state. In 2000 nuclear power supplied roughly a third of electricity and new reactors were still being built, hence nuclear_expansion. 'social_market_economy' approximates the coordinated postwar model; large public corporations (postal savings, highway corporations) were still state-owned in 2000.
